    How the kilns were found. YOLO11 detector on Sentinel-2 winter composites, filtered by land cover, kept only if hot in ≥12% of clear images, with airports, refineries and year-round heat sources removed. Every kiln within 800 m of a school (1,133) was then checked by eye on Esri imagery, with older captures for hazy ones, and so was every kiln whose Earth Engine heat record showed weak firing; 166 non-kilns were removed. School points shared by schools of different villages (3,090) were dropped as misplaced.
    Data. Copernicus Sentinel-2 (ESA); SentinelKilnDB (IIT Gandhinagar, CC BY-NC 4.0); ESA WorldCover; WorldPop 2020; UDISE school locations via DataMeet; OpenStreetMap contributors; NCRPB districts (pre-2023, rebuilt).
